summary: Primary-source review since 2026-11-06: BLS October 2026 Employment Situation released Nov 6 reports +165,000 nonfarm payroll jobs (observed aggregate employment), including -1,000 in information; these figures do not establish AI-related displacement or adoption. No independently verified new AI-specific labor-market evidence materially changes Career Radar. Earlier ILO/OECD/IMF findings and unverified secondary claims are not duplicated.
